<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<?import javafx.geometry.*?> <?import javafx.scene.control.*?> <?import javafx.scene.layout.*?>
<VBox spacing="25" style="-fx-padding: 30; -fx-background-color: #f5f5f5;" xmlns="http://javafx.com/javafx/17.0.12" xmlns:fx="http://javafx.com/fxml/1" fx:controller="controllers.HomeAdminController">
<!-- Header --> <Label style="-fx-font-size: 28; -fx-font-weight: bold; -fx-text-fill: #333333;" text=" Gestion des Réclamations" />
<!-- Filters Section --> <VBox spacing="15" style="-fx-background-color: white; -fx-border-color: #e0e0e0; -fx-border-radius: 8; -fx-padding: 25; -fx-effect: dropshadow(gaussian, rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 5, 0, 0, 2);">
<!-- Title --> <Label style="-fx-font-size: 14; -fx-font-weight: bold; -fx-text-fill: #555555;" text="Filtres et Recherche" />
<!-- Filter Row 1 --> <HBox prefHeight="76.0" prefWidth="1109.0" spacing="20" style="-fx-alignment: top-left;">
<!-- Search by Title --> <VBox spacing="8" style="-fx-min-width: 350; -fx-pref-width: 350;"> <Label style="-fx-font-size: 12; -fx-font-weight: bold; -fx-text-fill: #333333;" text="TITRE / UTILISATEUR *" /> <TextField fx:id="searchField" prefHeight="50.0" prefWidth="350.0" promptText="Rechercher par titre ou utilisateur..." style="-fx-font-size: 12; -fx-padding: 12; -fx-border-color: #d0d0d0; -fx-border-radius: 5; -fx-border-width: 1;" /> </VBox>
<!-- Filter by Status --> <VBox spacing="8" style="-fx-min-width: 220;"> <Label style="-fx-font-size: 12; -fx-font-weight: bold; -fx-text-fill: #333333;" text="STATUT" /> <ComboBox fx:id="statusFilter" prefHeight="50.0" prefWidth="128.0" promptText="Tous" style="-fx-font-size: 12; -fx-padding: 12; -fx-border-radius: 5;" /> </VBox>
<!-- Filter by Date --> <VBox spacing="8" style="-fx-min-width: 220;"> <Label style="-fx-font-size: 12; -fx-font-weight: bold; -fx-text-fill: #333333;" text="DATE" /> <DatePicker fx:id="dateFilter" prefHeight="50.0" prefWidth="166.0" promptText="jj/mm/aaaa" style="-fx-font-size: 12; -fx-padding: 12; -fx-border-radius: 5;" /> </VBox> <Button onAction="#resetFilters" prefHeight="59.0" prefWidth="126.0" style="-fx-font-size: 12; -fx-padding: 12 20; -fx-background-color: white; -fx-text-fill: #666666; -fx-border-radius: 5; -fx-cursor: hand; -fx-font-weight: bold; -fx-border-color: #cccccc;" text="Réinitialiser"> <HBox.margin> <Insets top="20.0" /> </HBox.margin> </Button>
<!-- Search Button --> <VBox spacing="8" style="-fx-pref-width: 80; -fx-alignment: bottom-left;" />
</HBox>
<!-- Filter Row 2 - Sort --> <HBox spacing="20" style="-fx-alignment: center-left;">
<!-- Sort By --> <VBox spacing="8" style="-fx-min-width: 200;"> <Label style="-fx-font-size: 12; -fx-font-weight: bold; -fx-text-fill: #333333;" text="TRIER PAR" /> <ComboBox fx:id="sortByField" prefHeight="38.0" prefWidth="162.0" promptText="Date (défaut)" style="-fx-font-size: 12; -fx-padding: 10; -fx-border-radius: 5;" /> </VBox>
<!-- Sort Order (ASC/DESC) --> <VBox spacing="8" style="-fx-min-width: 160;"> <Label style="-fx-font-size: 12; -fx-font-weight: bold; -fx-text-fill: #333333;" text="ORDRE" /> <ComboBox fx:id="sortOrder" prefHeight="46.0" prefWidth="132.0" promptText="↓ DESC" style="-fx-font-size: 12; -fx-padding: 10; -fx-border-radius: 5;" /> </VBox>
</HBox>
</VBox>
<!-- Table Section --> <VBox spacing="10" style="-fx-background-color: white; -fx-border-color: #e0e0e0; -fx-border-radius: 8; -fx-padding: 25; -fx-grow: ALWAYS; -fx-effect: dropshadow(gaussian, rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 5, 0, 0, 2);">
<TableView fx:id="table" style="-fx-font-size: 12; -fx-table-cell-border-color: #f0f0f0;"> <columnResizePolicy> <TableView fx:constant="CONSTRAINED_RESIZE_POLICY" /> </columnResizePolicy> <columns> <TableColumn fx:id="colTitre" prefWidth="300" text="TITRE" /> <TableColumn fx:id="colDate" prefWidth="150" text="DATE" /> <TableColumn fx:id="colStatut" prefWidth="130" text="STATUT" /> <TableColumn fx:id="colAction" prefWidth="220" text="ACTIONS" /> </columns> </TableView>
</VBox>
</VBox>
